bullets.title: TSMC: Raises 2026 revenue guide to +44%; AI demand 'extremely strong'; capex heading higher
bullets.body: TSMC 3Q revenue $46.7B beat consensus $45.4B; 4Q guided to $53.3B vs. consensus $50.1B. Management raised FY26 revenue growth to +44% (prior >+40%) on robust AI/HPC demand with no slowdown signals; 2nm contributed 8% of wafer revenue, N2 capacity to more than double in 2027. Analysts raised 2027 capex estimate to $83-94B, with advanced node pricing up 5-10% from 1Q27; AI accelerator CAGR likely above prior 'mid-high 50s%' through 2029.

bullets.title: AI/Neocloud sell-off: CRWV -15%, NBIS -10%, DELL -11% as HY spreads blow out 59bps MTD
bullets.body: Hot CPI print triggered a broad AI infrastructure unwind; GS reports hedge funds net sold Global AI stocks for 5 consecutive sessions, reversing all cumulative net buying since start of 2025, with TMT L/S funds down -4.5% MTD. HY spreads widened +59bps MTD to 324bps; CoreWeave CDS implies ~50% 5-year default probability with bonds at 78c yielding 15%. Hedgeye maintains core shorts in CRWV, IREN, NBIS citing levered neocloud financing mismatch (short-duration GPUs financed with long-term debt).

bullets.title: NVDA: Shifted to neutral trend by Hedgeye; Germany AI partnership; Huang says no CRWV backstop needed
bullets.body: NVIDIA CEO Huang said the company doesn't need to backstop CoreWeave during a Sweden event; CRWV shares came off lows but remain down ~3%. Germany and NVIDIA are in talks on a new AI partnership with several hundred million euros in investment commitment. Hedgeye's McCullough shifted NVDA to neutral trend and said he would not be long at current signal levels.

bullets.title: CRWV: DA Davidson upgrades to Buy $110 PT; Mizuho cuts PT to $88 on financing risk
bullets.body: DA Davidson upgraded CRWV to Buy with $110 PT (from $68), citing de-risking events and AI compute demand; NVIDIA invested $2B at $87.20/share (~9% stake) and will leverage its balance sheet to accelerate CoreWeave's infrastructure procurement. Mizuho's Klein cut CRWV PT to $88 from $115 citing financing concerns — debt yields hitting 15%, short-duration GPU assets financed with long-term debt — though GPU lease rates continue rising across generations.

bullets.title: TTWO: Citi upgrades to Buy $270 PT; $900M in unaccounted capitalized costs points to Red Dead III in 2027-28
bullets.body: Citi upgrades TTWO to Buy with $270 PT (34.2% upside from $201.23), noting GTA VI dev costs of $1.5B leave $900M of the $2.4B total capitalized software costs unaccounted for — a record level that Citi believes could be Red Dead Redemption III targeting 2027-28 release. The $270 target implies ~26x FY28E non-GAAP EPS, below the 5-year historical NTM PE multiple.

bullets.title: OTAs: Agentic AI existential threat; ABNB upgraded to Best Idea Long, EXPE stays Short Bias
bullets.body: Hedgeye upgrades ABNB to Best Idea Long citing fragmented inventory base as a structural advantage against agentic AI disruption; EXPE scores worst on OTA scorecard with weak engagement, high agentic exposure, and downside risk to 2027-29 margin consensus. Meta's Muse and Instinct now complete full travel bookings via browser automation bypassing OTA platforms entirely — payments/merchant-of-record bottlenecks resolved — putting billions in OTA commission income at risk; OTA stocks down 15-25% YTD.

bullets.title: ACN: Investor Day — first-ever mid-term guide; FY29 acceleration to mid-high single digit growth, Network biz to 12% of revenue
bullets.body: Accenture issued first-ever mid-term guidance: mid-single digit CC growth FY27-28 stepping up to mid-to-high single digits FY29, with Network of Businesses (currently 6% of revenue) expected to ~30% CAGR and double to 12% of revenue. TAM has doubled to ~$3T; $50M+ data/AI deals rose from 4 in 2023 to ~50 today; agentic commerce pipeline grew from zero in January to $1B booked. JPM maintains Overweight; Mizuho maintains Outperform, targeting +10-30bps annual margin expansion through FY29.

bullets.title: NOW, MSFT, TEAM: Mizuho raises PTs on enterprise software strength amid AI selloff
bullets.body: Mizuho's Klein raises NOW PT to $170 on Federal strength, new SKUs, and 20% cRPO upside expected; raises MSFT PT to $600 on Azure growth above 44-45% guidance; raises TEAM PT to $235 on JSM strength at 17-18x CY28E FCF on 20% ARR growth. Klein characterizes software as still in bull market with no trend breakdown, distinguishing it from semis and neocloud.

bullets.title: NFLX: Jefferies maintains Buy $850 PT; 22% annual EPS growth supported by ads (~35% CAGR) and margin expansion
bullets.body: Jefferies sees NFLX revenue growing ~11% annually 2026-29 with ARM +6%/year and advertising revenue +35% annually, combined with ~190bps annual EBIT margin expansion supporting ~22% annual EPS growth. NFLX trades at ~16x NTM GAAP P/E with room for multiple expansion as M&A and viewing hours per member visibility improves. Risk: Citi flags GOOGL/YouTube developing an audiobook feature for 2027 that could pressure SPOT and NFLX engagement.

bullets.title: EQIX: 3Q revenue +10.7% y/y to $2.56B, AFFOPS +8%; AI inference demand accelerating capacity
bullets.body: Citi TMT digest reports EQIX 3Q revenue of $2.56B (+10.7% y/y) with AFFOPS of $10.62 (+8%); accelerated capacity build-out into 2026 positions the company to benefit from AI inference demand surge. Morgan Stanley forecasts $1.5T hyperscaler capex in 2027 with U.S. facing 30%+ power shortfall for data centers through 2028, supporting secular demand.

bullets.title: WULF: Morgan Stanley says 'severely mispriced'; ~$1.5B NOI signed contracts, sub-$10/watt build costs
bullets.body: MS characterizes WULF as severely mispriced with ~$1.5B in signed NOI contracts and sub-$10/watt build costs. Separately, Mizuho sees stock decline disconnected from contract value with upcoming catalysts including a Hawesville credit backstop and new project announcements. WULF hit 52-week lows in today's session.

bullets.title: INTU: Acquires Sequence (Series A revenue management automation); no terms disclosed
bullets.body: Intuit announced acquisition of Sequence, a Series A company automating end-to-end quote-to-revenue processes for businesses. Financial terms were not disclosed. Citi TMT notes INTU remains a consensus short questioned on valuation vs. fundamentals.

bullets.title: NBIS, IREN, CORZ, OKLO, QBTS, WULF: Multiple AI/energy names hitting 52-week lows
bullets.body: StreetAccount flags CRWV, IREN, OKLO, QBTS, WULF, and CORZ all reaching 52-week lows in today's session. Electronic Technology sector has 0 new 52-week highs and 29 lows, with Technology Services showing 6 highs and 28 lows — reflecting the concentrated AI infrastructure sell-off.

bullets.title: NVDA 1.6T networking: Roth surveying whether it cannibalizes 800G; value shift across optical/switch vendors
bullets.body: Roth QSG Vol. 7 survey assesses whether 1.6T AI networking shipments are displacing 800G and how NVIDIA's expanding Spectrum-X Ethernet adoption is shifting value among AVGO, MRVL, ANET, FN, GLW, CIEN, CRDO, LITE, and COHR. Conversion to material 1.6T volume remains uncertain with 800G displacement rate unclear.

bullets.title: CVNA: MS trims 3Q EBITDA 2% to $797M; PT cut to $88 from $90 on financing margin pressure from higher rates
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley trims CVNA 3Q EBITDA estimate by 2% to $797M, viewing 3Q as a clearing event. PT cut to $88 from $90 with financing margin pressure from higher rates identified as the key headwind.

bullets.title: AMZN/GOOGL grocery: Amazon Fresh produce doubled; Walmart+ skewing affluent while losing low-income
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley data shows Amazon Fresh produce sales doubled to $423M/13 weeks following the August 2025 same-day perishables launch, with household penetration rising from 3.4% to 6.6%, though per-buyer spend remains flat at ~$47. Walmart+ is losing low-income household penetration (~43bps) while gaining with high-income and Millennial/Gen Z cohorts; GOOGL YouTube developing hotel booking inside AI Mode and an audiobook feature targeting 2027, pressuring SPOT.

bullets.title: ASAN: AI Teammates interest strong at Work Innovation Summit; mgmt prioritizing AI R&D over near-term margin
bullets.body: Citi TMT notes ASAN's Work Innovation Summit showed strong customer interest in AI Teammates product; management is explicitly prioritizing AI R&D and GTM investment over margin expansion in the near term, a trade-off investors appear constructive on.

bullets.title: ACN Investor Day: JPM OW, Mizuho OP both reiterate on AI-driven TAM doubling to $3T
bullets.body: Post-ACN Investor Day, JPMorgan maintains Overweight with confidence in AI growth thesis; only 5% of clients have the AI foundation to scale, creating a large deal pipeline. Mizuho highlights AI & data workforce grown to 110K from 40K with 18K+ advanced AI projects delivered since Nov 2022, and FCF conversion target of 110%+.

bullets.title: Hedgeye: Exits semis, short ORCL on credit stress; McCullough would not be long NVDA at current signal
bullets.body: Hedgeye's McCullough exited semiconductor exposure, shifted NVDA to neutral trend, and maintains ORCL as a short citing 2x cash flow spending as unsustainable alongside CRWV's 4x. Software equities remain in bull market trend per Hedgeye, but McCullough warns of a Quad 4 transition with January-February as the first monthly period of growth deterioration that would challenge tech.

bullets.title: OCP Day 3: 800VDC adoption slower than expected; NVDA Rubin Ultra may need only ~600kW; data center power now primary bottleneck
bullets.body: OCP Day 3 takeaways show 800VDC rack shipments expected only in small volumes in 2H27 primarily from Google, as NVIDIA Rubin Ultra racks may require lower power (~600kW) than anticipated. Data center power constraints now exceed supply constraints as primary bottleneck, with supply issues in MOSFETs, power semis, and capacitors further slowing adoption. Amphenol and TE Connectivity positioned to benefit from higher interconnect/power-delivery content per GPU as hybrid copper-optical architectures gain traction.
